_comment: Floors for the SYNTHETIC regression fixture (docs/mast-bench-synth.jsonl, 180 records from scripts/make_synth_corpus.py, seed 20260919). Scenarios plant failure modes by construction, so the detectors must score near-perfectly: any drop below these floors is a detector regression, not data noise. These numbers describe the fixture only and must never be quoted as real-world performance - see the gold-corpus floors in bench-floors.json for that (n=27).
